catch.guide.title: How to play
catch.guide.intro: Catch creatures, fill your Dex and earn coins. Everything here is private to you.
catch.guide.catching.name: Catching
catch.guide.catching.body: While people chat in a catch channel, wild creatures appear. Press the button on one to throw a capsule before it runs away. Check **Play > Wild zone** to see what is out there, or call your own with **Encounter** (it has a cooldown).
catch.guide.items.name: Capsules and berries
catch.guide.items.body: A stronger capsule gives better odds. A berry adds a little extra catch chance. If you run out, claim your **Daily** reward or buy more in the **Shop**. **Inventory** shows what you have.
catch.guide.rarity.name: Rarity
catch.guide.rarity.body: {common} Common · {uncommon} Uncommon · {rare} Rare · {epic} Epic · {mythic} Mythic. Rarer creatures are harder to catch and sell for more. {shiny} Shiny creatures are special variants worth extra.
catch.guide.coins.name: Coins
catch.guide.coins.body: Earn coins from your **Daily** reward (keep your streak going) and by selling creatures in **Economy > Sell**. Spend them in the **Shop**. **Wallet** shows your recent activity.
catch.guide.collection.name: Collection and Dex
catch.guide.collection.body: **Collection** lists every creature you own. Open one to see its stats, favourite or lock it (both protect it from being sold), give it a nickname, make it your buddy, or evolve it once it is ready. **Trainer card** (in Collection) shows your profile. **Dex** tracks which species you have seen and caught. **Info > Status** shows your progress.
